description: Public Telegram channel from its t.me/s preview page: title, description, subscriber/photo/video/link counts, and the latest ~20 posts with text, view count text and time. Only public channels that show a preview; private chats and groups are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_telegram_homepage when you need latest public posts of one Telegram channel as shown on its; social_telegram_keyword_search when you need keyword search inside one public Telegram channel, using. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

channel.description: Public channel username without @ (5-32 letters, digits or _)
